Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed room counts, building ages, specialized spaces, and site plans (Chunks 21-63). Facility condition assessment uses ASTM E2018-15 standard with detailed system evaluations and cost estimates, linking condition data to capital planning and student outcomes (Chunks 11-14, 21-63).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections through 2029-30 with methodology and demographic analysis; capacity utilization data by site and grade with square footage and student counts; explicit connection of enrollment trends to facility actions including portables and new construction (Chunks 8-10, 23-25).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications covering diverse programs (CTE, TK, special education, STEM, VAPA), facility requirements, and direct linkage of projects to educational goals (Chunks 65-87). The plan integrates district mission and instructional priorities with facilities planning.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Outdoor greening and climate-adapted design are central elements with districtwide data on outdoor learning spaces, shade, play yard redesign, and stormwater management; strategies include outdoor classrooms, shade structures, permeable surfaces, and environmental literacy (Chunks 85-87).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate impacts with detailed strategies such as shade structures, HVAC upgrades, and stormwater management; climate readiness is a theme in the plan and integrated into projects and long-range planning, though comprehensive multi-impact districtwide risk assessment details are limited (Chunks 5-6, 19).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies like solar panels, LED lighting, HVAC upgrades, and references to energy resilience goals; mentions state requirements (Title 24, ZNE) and some electrification plans, but lacks fully comprehensive energy resilience strategies and detailed energy use data (Chunks 19, 29).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates by project and system, prioritization framework based on safety, equity, and program needs, and multiple funding sources including bonds, state programs, and alternative financing; includes long-term financial sustainability considerations (Chunks 18-20, 63-64).
